what: the same seven arms of3t-trajwide ran, all scored at 20 of 20 rungs instead of 9. The break controls are what make the shipped arm's 2.564253e-01 readable: without them a number between 0 and 1 could be anything.
scope: diffusion_module, 573 of 761 reference tensors, 88.08194359237523 % of the model's squared gradient norm. theirs_aa2 reads 89.2106 % because the reference against itself covers all 761 of its own tensors, not the 573 our device arm reaches.
host: qb2 (tt-quietbox2), device arms on cards 0 and 1 of one p300c board pair, reference arms CPU only, OMP_NUM_THREADS=3. Scored on qb2.

reads.instrument_is_deterministic: theirs_aa2 against theirs is EXACTLY 0.0 at all 20 rungs with 761 of 761 tensors bit-identical, so every magnitude below is readable.
reads.our_arm_is_deterministic: shipped_aa2 reproduces shipped to every recorded digit (2.564253e-01 at k=20, growth exponent -0.2772440946), so the device arm repeats.
reads.saturation: zero (the model's own gradient replaced by zero) reads exactly 1.000000 at every rung, which is what a d_k of zero against a moving reference must read. shipped sits 3.90x below saturation.
reads.break_controls_move: norebind (skip rebind, so step k+1 reads the weights discovery saw) reads 8.563583e-01, 3.34x shipped; permute (gradients handed over under a rotated name map) reads 8.598760e-01, 3.35x shipped with a worst tensor of 2.5412, above 1.0. Both flip the growth exponent POSITIVE (+0.2354, +0.2347) where shipped and stale are negative, so the SIGN of the growth law separates a healthy loop from a broken one.
reads.the_weak_control: stale (step k+1 reads the weights step k-1 wrote) reads 3.139635e-01, only 1.22x shipped. It moves, and it is the least sensitive of the three: 20 warmup steps move the weights about 1e-6 relative, so one step of staleness is a small perturbation. This instrument is weakly sensitive to weight FRESHNESS and strongly sensitive to weight IDENTITY and to the name map. Stated rather than left for a reader to infer from the table.
